name: Tied knockout predictions surface an extra-time or penalties resolution
description: Browse several knockout match prediction pages; any that show a level scoreline must also display an ET or PENS resolution indicator.

planSteps.description: Read the predicted scoreline in the prediction block

Verify that when the predicted scoreline is level the prediction block also surfaces an extra-time or penalties resolution naming the advancing team; when the scoreline is decisive, verify the block names a clear winner without a resolution indicator
